note: Health-owned descriptor for retired gymnastics blocks. It carries titles and session labels ONLY — whether a session was actually done, and when, lives in the health_gymnastics_progress rows in Turso. Companion App mirrors this file byte-for-byte into src/data/gymnastics-archive.json and renders it read-only.

blocks.title: Ordinary Kipping Pull-Up Capacity
blocks.subtitle: 3-week kipping capacity block
blocks.outcome: Closed after the 50-rep WOD application: 6×5 plus 5×4 in 8:15 on 18 August, tiring but not near failure, during the FMD and a day after 36 strict chin-ups plus bench press. That practical application superseded the isolated clean-forty gate — repeatable fives and an early downshift to fours are established, so ordinary kipping moved to WOD maintenance and toes-to-bar became the next primary block.

blocks.title: Link Two Kipping Pull-Ups
blocks.subtitle: 2-week focused kipping block
blocks.outcome: Closed after four linked reps became repeatable on 60-second rests. Linking stopped being the limiter, which is what handed the work to the kipping-capacity block.

blocks.title: Kipping, Butterfly & Toes-to-Bar
blocks.subtitle: 10-week gymnastics skill add-on
blocks.outcome: Retired before any session was completed; replaced by the focused kipping-pair block.
